results.question: Which pianos need repair, and where are they?
results.sql:
SELECT 
    p.brand AS piano_brand,
    p.model AS piano_model,
    p.serial_number AS piano_serial_number,
    r.room_number AS room_number,
    b.name AS building_name
FROM 
    piano p
JOIN 
    repair_request rr ON p.piano_id = rr.piano_id
JOIN 
    room r ON p.room_id = r.room_id
JOIN 
    building b ON r.building_id = b.building_id
WHERE 
    p.status = 'needs repair' AND rr.status = 'open';
results.answer:
The following pianos need repair:

1. A Yamaha U1 with serial number YM-554377 located in room C-302 of the Harris Fine Arts Center.
2. A Baldwin Hamilton with serial number BW-310045 located in the Lobby of the Wilkinson Student Center.

results.question: Which pianos have never been tuned?
results.sql:
SELECT p.brand, p.model, p.piano_type, p.serial_number, p.year_made
FROM piano p
LEFT JOIN tuning t ON p.piano_id = t.piano_id
WHERE t.piano_id IS NULL;
results.answer:
The following pianos have never been tuned: 

1. Yamaha P-125 (digital, serial number YM-D77120, year made 2020)
2. Steinway & Sons Model M (baby grand, serial number ST-071122, year made 1989)
3. Roland FP-30X (digital, serial number RL-D55671, year made 2022)

results.question: Who tuned the Steinway in the concert hall most recently?
results.sql:
SELECT t.name AS technician_name, tu.tuning_date
FROM tuning tu
JOIN piano p ON tu.piano_id = p.piano_id
JOIN room r ON p.room_id = r.room_id
JOIN technician t ON tu.technician_id = t.technician_id
WHERE p.brand = 'Steinway' AND r.room_type = 'concert hall'
ORDER BY tu.tuning_date DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: Which technicians are not certified, and which pianos did they tune?
results.sql:
SELECT t.name AS technician_name, p.brand AS piano_brand, p.model AS piano_model, tu.tuning_date
FROM technician t
JOIN tuning tu ON t.technician_id = tu.technician_id
JOIN piano p ON tu.piano_id = p.piano_id
WHERE t.is_certified = 0;
results.answer:
The technician who is not certified is Tom Alvarez. He tuned the following pianos:

1. Baldwin Hamilton on May 14, 2024
2. Young Chang G-157 on November 2, 2025
3. Baldwin Acrosonic on September 9, 2023

results.question: Which students have reported more than one repair request?
results.sql:
SELECT s.name, s.email, COUNT(rr.request_id) AS request_count
FROM student s
JOIN repair_request rr ON s.student_id = rr.student_id
WHERE rr.student_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.student_id
HAVING COUNT(rr.request_id) > 1;

results.question: How many pianos are in each building?
results.sql:
SELECT b.name AS building_name, COUNT(p.piano_id) AS piano_count
FROM building b
LEFT JOIN room r ON b.building_id = r.building_id
LEFT JOIN piano p ON r.room_id = p.room_id
GROUP BY b.building_id, b.name;
results.answer:
The number of pianos in each building is as follows: 

- Harris Fine Arts Center: 6 pianos
- Wilkinson Student Center: 2 pianos
- Harold B. Lee Library: 1 piano
- Joseph Smith Building: 2 pianos
- Brimhall Building: 2 pianos

results.question: Which pianos haven't been tuned in the last 6 months?
results.sql:
SELECT p.brand, p.model, p.piano_type, p.serial_number, p.year_made, p.status
FROM piano p
LEFT JOIN tuning t ON p.piano_id = t.piano_id AND t.tuning_date >= date('2026-10-12', '-6 months')
WHERE t.tuning_id IS NULL;

results.question: Which students have reserved a piano that currently needs repair?
results.sql:
SELECT s.name AS student_name, s.email AS student_email, p.brand AS piano_brand, p.model AS piano_model
FROM reservation r
JOIN piano p ON r.piano_id = p.piano_id
JOIN student s ON r.student_id = s.student_id
WHERE p.status = 'needs repair';
results.answer: Ben Okafor has reserved a Yamaha U1 piano that currently needs repair.

results.question: Which piano has the most open repair requests?
results.sql:
SELECT p.brand, p.model, COUNT(rr.request_id) AS open_requests
FROM piano p
JOIN repair_request rr ON p.piano_id = rr.piano_id
WHERE rr.status = 'open'
GROUP BY p.piano_id
ORDER BY open_requests DESC
LIMIT 1;
results.answer: The piano with the most open repair requests is a Young Chang G-157, with 1 open request.

results.question: Can I reserve a piano in the Brimhall Building?
results.sql:
SELECT r.room_number, b.name AS building_name, p.brand, p.model
FROM reservation res
JOIN piano p ON res.piano_id = p.piano_id
JOIN room r ON p.room_id = r.room_id
JOIN building b ON r.building_id = b.building_id
WHERE b.name = 'Brimhall Building' 
  AND res.start_time > '2026-10-12' 
  AND res.end_time < '2026-10-12';
